claims.text: Bellagio was inspired by the villages of Europe and overlooks a Mediterranean-blue lake with fountains.

findings.quote: Inspired by the villages of Europe, Bellagio overlooks a Mediterranean-blue lake with fountains performing a magnificent ballet.

claims.text: Bellagio sits at Center Strip, directly across from Paris and Caesars, with the fountains as its front yard.

findings.quote: Center Strip, directly across from Paris and Caesars, with the fountains acting as both front yard and landmark.

claims.text: From Bellagio you can walk to Caesars, Paris, Aria, Cosmopolitan and the Shops at Crystals.

findings.quote: You can walk to Caesars, Paris, Aria, Cosmopolitan, and the Shops at Crystals without much logistical drama

claims.text: Bellagio has a Dale Chihuly glass ceiling.

findings.quote: complete with the dancing fountains, Dale Chihuly glass ceiling, and a level of floral theater

claims.text: The Fountain View King, in the Bellagio Tower, has a view of the Fountains of Bellagio.

findings.quote: Located in the Bellagio Tower, the Fountain View King is a blissful refuge of relaxation with a breathtaking view of the Fountains of Bellagio.

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Bellagio Suite is an Italian-inspired residential-style suite.

findings.quote: Two Bedroom Bellagio Suite
enjoy the opulent and sophisticated designs of this Italian-inspired residential-style suite.

claims.text: The One Bedroom Lakeview Suite has views of the lake.

findings.quote: One Bedroom Lakeview Suite
Take in stunning views of the lake as you relax in this marvelous layout of luxury during your stay.

claims.text: Many Bellagio rooms have fountain views, and bathrooms lean heavily on marble and soaking tubs.

findings.quote: many with fountain views, and bathrooms that lean heavy on marble and soaking tubs

claims.text: The pool's private cabanas have lounge seating and personal bar service.

findings.quote: newly remodeled private cabanas elevated with luxurious lounge seating and personal bar service

claims.text: Bellagio is home to the aquatic production "O" by Cirque du Soleil.

findings.quote: Enjoy the Skill and artistry of Cirque du Soleil's inimitable acrobats, swimmers, divers and dancers in this aquatic-themed production of "O."

claims.text: Carbone Riviera, from Major Food Group, has some tables facing the fountains.

findings.quote: Major Food Group’s seafood-driven sibling to Carbone
with whole fish, crudos, and some of the most coveted tables facing the fountains

claims.text: The Pinky Ring by Bruno Mars is a cocktail lounge at Bellagio.

findings.quote: THE PINKY RING BY BRUNO MARS
A one of a kind cocktail lounge, curated by an entertainer for your entertainment pleasure.

claims.text: The Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens show floral displays that change with the seasons.

findings.quote: Witness the seasons change through breathtaking, larger-than-life floral masterpieces.

claims.text: Spa Tower rooms and suites were redesigned by Champalimaud with a Lake Como palette and custom furnishings.

findings.quote: redesigned by Champalimaud with a Lake Como palette, custom furnishings

claims.text: The Bellagio Pool has an Italian-inspired pool courtyard, set among cypress trees and courtyards.

findings.quote: Bask in the aesthetic of an Italian-inspired experience and take in the grandeur of our newly renovated pool courtyard.
The Bellagio pool complex remains one of the prettiest on the Strip, all cypress trees, courtyards

claims.text: The Bellagio Gallery of Fine Art hosts intimate exhibitions of artists.

findings.quote: Intimate exhibitions of the world's most compelling artists.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes that Bellagio's dining and room rates skew upscale.

findings.quote: though the dining and room rates skew upscale

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a busy casino environment with crowds and noise.
Bellagio is part of MGM Rewards, so stays can be combined with other MGM properties across the Strip.

findings.quote: Part of MGM Rewards, making it easy to combine stays with other MGM properties across the Strip.
